interactive.label: Generate
interactive.tooltip: Generate the VM decay or VV/VH pair and the sample anisotropy curve.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Save CSV, text, NumPy, JSON or a VV/VH file with detection calibration.

interactive.label: Fit group
interactive.tooltip: Register the generated dataset and create its lifetime fit group with calibration and shared parameters.

interactive.label: Browse IRF
interactive.tooltip: Choose an optional instrument response to convolve with the ideal decay.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain lifetime spectra, anisotropy, convolution and noise.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through generation, export and creating a fit group.

interactive.label: Add
interactive.tooltip: Add a lifetime component.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected lifetime component.

interactive.label: Load
interactive.tooltip: Load a lifetime spectrum from a CSV/text file (interleaved a,τ list or 2-column amplitude/lifetime table).

interactive.label: n_bins
interactive.tooltip: Number of micro-time (TAC) bins in the decay histogram.

interactive.label: bin_width
interactive.tooltip: Micro-time bin width in nanoseconds.

interactive.label: start_bin
interactive.tooltip: Bin index where the ideal decay begins (prompt offset).

interactive.label: irf_path
interactive.tooltip: Optional instrument response function file (text or .npy) to convolve with the decay. Empty = ideal decay.

interactive.label: Noise
interactive.tooltip: Poisson-sample a finite-count observation (uses Photons + Seed). Off = normalized ideal pattern.

interactive.label: photon_count
interactive.tooltip: Total photon count for the Poisson observation.

interactive.label: seed
interactive.tooltip: Random seed for the shot-noise realization (reproducible).

interactive.label: VM (magic angle)
interactive.tooltip: Detection mode. VM: magic angle — the decay carries no anisotropy. VV/VH: parallel and perpendicular channels generated with the rotation spectrum below; both share one photon budget when Noise is on.

interactive.label: VV/VH (polarized)
interactive.tooltip: Detection mode. VM: magic angle — the decay carries no anisotropy. VV/VH: parallel and perpendicular channels generated with the rotation spectrum below; both share one photon budget when Noise is on.

interactive.label: Add
interactive.tooltip: Add a rotational correlation component.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected rotational correlation component.
